creative_direction: Paint a sleeping red fox curled into a rounded ring, with its long tail wrapped around the muzzle. Use a broad russet body shape, an ivory tail tip, two charcoal ear tips, and one small curved line for the closed eye. Place the animal at the center of an icy blue square, leaving a wide border of clean space. The back and tail should make an appealing uninterrupted outer contour, while a small interior gap reveals the curl. No fur strands, forest props, or blanket. A subtle dry paper edge is enough to suggest paint. Keep the anatomy plausible and the mood restful rather than infantile.
